transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess the main thing is work. I'm an insurance claims clerk, and... I just keep getting up from my workstation during the day. Even when I know I'm supposed to just stay put and finish my claim reviews. So... yeah. That's what pushed me to come in.
When you feel the urge to get up from your workstation, is it because a specific unwanted thought or fear keeps bothering you until you stand up?
No, not really. It's not like a fear or anything. I just... I don't know, I just get up.
When you're sitting at your workstation, do you feel restless?
Um... I guess so. Yeah. Just... kind of antsy, maybe. I don't really know how to describe it.
Did you often feel this same kind of restless, hard-to-stay-seated feeling when you were a child?

Um... I don't know about feeling restless, exactly. But... I guess struggling with my work isn't brand new for me. Like, back in elementary school... my teachers used to write that I was bright, but... I was always losing my worksheets. Or I'd miss the instructions. They always had to give me reminders to actually finish my classwork. So... yeah. I guess.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on a task, even when you want to finish it?

Yeah... I guess so. Like, if people near me start talking about another claim, or... if I just remember some random errand I need to do. I don't know, my attention just sort of... slides off what I'm doing. And then I end up having to reread the same section a few times.
Do you spend a lot of the day worrying about different things?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I worry more than anyone else. Just... normal stuff, I guess.
Do you often do things on impulse without thinking them through?
Um... no. I don't really think so. I'm not really the spontaneous type, I guess. I just kind of stick to my normal routine.
